run_ml_train_co2r: run the ML training script for CO2R reaction with random forest model on both sources
run_ml_train_her: run the ML training script for HER reaction with linear regression model on vsp source
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run the ML training script with Matminer elemental features enabled for CO2R analysis
run_ml_train_loo_cv: run the ML training script using leave-one-out cross-validation for CO2R product prediction
run_ml_train_from_processed_df: run the ML training script using a preprocessed dataframe file instead of raw CSV inputs
